extensionManaged: Provided by the {{extension}} extension, which manages its address, API key and models.
noModelFoundExtensionDesc: The extension has not listed any models yet. Check its settings, such as its API key.
limitedSupport: This provider may not be fully supported. Capabilities (tools, vision, audio) are not auto-detected - add models manually and configure capabilities per model.
mlxExperimental: MLX support is experimental. Embeddings are unavailable, the reasoning toggle is not yet wired through, and some newer model architectures may fail to load. Report issues on GitHub so we can prioritize them.
engineBundled: The inference engine is built into Jan, so there is nothing to download or update separately. Quote this version when reporting a model that fails to load.
engineOtherVersion: Need a different llama.cpp version? Run your own llama-server and add it as a custom OpenAI-compatible provider.
refreshModelsError: Provider must have base URL and at least one API key configured to fetch models.
noNewModels: No new models found. All available models are already added.
refreshModelsFailed: Failed to fetch models from {{provider}}. Please check your API key and base URL.
embeddingModelsDesc: Used for RAG and vector search. The selected model becomes the default when generating embeddings.
importedTooltip: Imported from a local file. Removing it from Jan will not delete the file on disk.
noModelFoundDesc: Available models will be listed here. If you don't have any models yet, visit the Hub to download.
noModelFoundRemoteDesc: Available models will be listed here. Use the refresh button above to fetch models from the provider, or add one manually with the + button.

diagnostics.title: Hardware check
diagnostics.description: Run every llama.cpp operation on your devices and check the results are correct. Useful when a model fails to load or gives bad output.
diagnostics.verdictPassedDetail: Every operation returned the right answer.
diagnostics.verdictFallbackDetail_one: 1 operation type is not fully implemented here. If a model uses it, that part of the work runs on the CPU instead. A model that does not use it is unaffected.
diagnostics.verdictFallbackDetail_other: {{count}} operation types are not fully implemented here. If a model uses one, that part of the work runs on the CPU instead. A model that does not use them is unaffected.
diagnostics.verdictFailedDetail_one: 1 operation returned the wrong answer. A model using it will produce bad output or fail to load.
diagnostics.verdictFailedDetail_other: {{count}} operations returned the wrong answer. A model using them will produce bad output or fail to load.
diagnostics.verdictCrashedDetail: The check process died on this device. A model would stop the same way.
diagnostics.verdictUnknownDetail: No results for this device yet.
diagnostics.quantizedWarning_one: 1 failure is in quantized kernels, which every local model uses.
diagnostics.quantizedWarning_other: {{count}} failures are in quantized kernels, which every local model uses.
diagnostics.fullConfirmBody: The full check tests every operation. It takes 15 minutes or more per device and uses every CPU core.
diagnostics.fullConfirmDriver: On Windows, a long GPU test can reset the display driver, which would interrupt anything you have loaded.
diagnostics.fullConfirmLoaded_one: 1 model is loaded and will compete for memory.
diagnostics.fullConfirmLoaded_other: {{count}} models are loaded and will compete for memory.
diagnostics.casesTruncated: Passing cases beyond the first {{count}} were not kept. Every failure is listed.
diagnostics.includeAllCases: Include every case in the copied report
diagnostics.groupMatrixMathDetail: The core calculation of every model. Most of the work happens here.
diagnostics.groupAttentionDetail: How the model decides which earlier words matter for the next one.
diagnostics.groupNormalizationDetail: Keeps numbers in a workable range between layers.
diagnostics.groupPositionalDetail: How the model tracks the order words came in.
diagnostics.groupConvolutionDetail: Used by image and audio models, not by plain chat models.
diagnostics.groupActivationDetail: The small shaping step applied after each layer.
diagnostics.groupMemoryDetail: Moving numbers around without changing them.
diagnostics.groupOtherDetail: Everything that does not fit the groups above.
diagnostics.quantizedDetail: Every model you download is compressed, so a failure here affects all of them.
diagnostics.busyBlocked: The check is unavailable while a model is loading or replying. Wait for it to finish, then run the check.
diagnostics.busyDuringRun: A model started working during this check. Results are still accurate, but the timings are not, and a failure here may be caused by competing for memory.
diagnostics.verdictInconclusiveDetail_one: 1 part of the check matched no test on this build of llama.cpp, so it was not checked. Run the full check to cover it.
diagnostics.verdictInconclusiveDetail_other: {{count}} parts of the check matched no test on this build of llama.cpp, so they were not checked. Run the full check to cover them.
diagnostics.verdictPartialDetail: This check stopped before every part of it had run on this device, so the parts that did pass are not the whole answer. Run it again to finish.
diagnostics.inconclusiveNotice: Some parts of this check tested nothing, so it is not a clean result. Run the full check to cover them.
diagnostics.suggestionTryAnotherDevice: Run your models on {{alternative}} instead of {{device}}.
diagnostics.suggestionTryAnotherDeviceDetail: {{device}} returned wrong answers, and {{alternative}} passed every check. Set the device in the model's settings.
diagnostics.suggestionReduceGpuLayers: Put fewer layers on {{device}}, or run on the processor.
diagnostics.suggestionReduceGpuLayersDetail_one: 1 part of the check stopped the test process on this device, which is what running out of video memory or losing the driver looks like.
diagnostics.suggestionReduceGpuLayersDetail_other: {{count}} parts of the check stopped the test process on this device, which is what running out of video memory or losing the driver looks like.
diagnostics.suggestionDisableFlashAttention: Turn flash attention off for models on {{device}}.
diagnostics.suggestionDisableFlashAttentionDetail_on: 1 attention check returned the wrong answer. Flash attention is optional, and turning it off uses the slower path that passed.
diagnostics.suggestionDisableFlashAttentionDetail_ot: {{count}} attention checks returned the wrong answer. Flash attention is optional, and turning it off uses the slower path that passed.
diagnostics.suggestionUseAnotherQuantization: Try a model with a different compression on {{device}}.
diagnostics.suggestionUseAnotherQuantizationDetail_o: 1 failure is in a compressed-weight operation while the uncompressed ones passed, so a differently compressed download may work.
{{count}} failures are in compressed-weight operations while the uncompressed ones passed, so a differently compressed download may work.
diagnostics.suggestionExpectCpuFallback: Some work may run on the CPU instead of {{device}}.
diagnostics.suggestionExpectCpuFallbackDetail_one: 1 operation type is not fully implemented on {{device}}. Whether this costs you any speed depends on the model: one that never uses it runs at full speed.
diagnostics.suggestionExpectCpuFallbackDetail_other: {{count}} operation types are not fully implemented on {{device}}. Whether this costs you any speed depends on the model: one that never uses them runs at full speed.
diagnostics.suggestionRerunWholeCheckDetail_one: 1 part of this check matched no test, so it was not checked at all. The full check does not narrow anything.
diagnostics.suggestionRerunWholeCheckDetail_other: {{count}} parts of this check matched no test, so they were not checked at all. The full check does not narrow anything.
diagnostics.verdictCpuUnsupportedDetail: Every operation your models need returned the right answer. The check also tries combinations no model builds, such as training-only operations, and those have no CPU version; that is normal on every machine.
